findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed black mold to be present at the caulking at mop sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure staff is monitoring caulking to prevent any possible mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed blood and chicken juice on the shelves at the corned beef and whole chicken areas. Properly clean and sanitizer these areas when they become soiled. The cases are open and very low. A toddler could easily get into this soil. It is known that these items leak regularly. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: The urinal in the men's rest room has what appears to be blood on it.  Clean with proper germicidal cleaner for this type of soil. 750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleansable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
No hot or warm water is available at the hand sink in the women's restroom. The men's hand sink is out of order waiting on a part for repair. Repair plumbing in restrooms and make sure warm water for hand washing is provided.
750-1120 Each lavatory shall be provided with hot and cold water tempered by means of a mixing valve or combination faucet.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed bread in racks being stacked directly on the floor in the back store room. Store bread at least 6 inches off the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the reach in chest freezer holding the Bremer 5 cheese lasagna and Bremer pierogies to have an accumulation of ice that is soiled along the sides of the freezer. Defrost and clean freezer.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed food on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Next to pallets stacked near the wall. Store food at least 6 inches off the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed ice build up in the walk-in cooler on the floor at door entrance. Observed ice build up in the walk-in freezer on the fans and vents of the compressor unit. Remove ice.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors of the walk-ins to be soiled with dust, food, and pallet debris. Clean the floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
